provenance.construction: Polynomial-minor CSS code from arXiv:2610.19459 (Nourozi, Smarandache, Mitchell), their Eqs. (10)-(11) at parameters of our own: over R_N = F_2[x]/(x^N+1), H_X(x) = [[a^top, b^top, c^top], [d^top, e^top, f^top]] with d = x^t c, e = a, f = b, and H_Z(x) = [b^2+ac, ab+x^t c^2, a^2 + x^t bc]; N = 147, t = 111, a/b/c = 4/4/4 terms, all codewords of the code generated by a sparse divisor g of x^N+1 with deg g = 84 and wt(g) = 4. Not one of the paper's 13 Table I instances, which stop at N = 85; found by enumerating sparse large-degree divisors of x^N+1 and sampling low-weight codewords of <g>.
